promptEs: En Mi mayor, ¿qué cifrado tiene la tríada diatónica del grado V?
promptEn: In E major, what is the symbol of the diatonic triad on degree V?
explanationEs: En Mi mayor, el grado V se construye sobre Si: Si-Re♯-Fa♯. La tercera Si-Re♯ es mayor y la quinta Si-Fa♯ es justa, así que la tríada es mayor y se cifra Si.
explanationEn: In E major, degree V is built on B: B-D♯-F♯. The third B-D♯ is major and the fifth B-F♯ is perfect, so the triad is major and its symbol is B.
